/* If the potential duplicate block has more than 2 records, the merge would take place, then 
 the Find donor routine is called with the merged donor's key data. Then all the new donors data 
 from the donor reel will be put back to the potential duplicates tables */

PROCEDURE after_merge IS

 s_set_id varchar2(10);
 Begin

 create_ids('DUPLI',s_set_id );
 insert into POTENTIAL_DUPLICATES (SET_ID,DONOR_ID,MERGE_FLAG,set_status_code,
 PROGRAM_ID,CHAPTER_ID)

 :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID
 from donor_reel where session_id = v_session_id and rownum<4;

 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from potential_duplicates where

 begin

 v_alt_id, v_alt_id_type -- SCR 11774

 exception

 handle_error;
 end;
 
 begin
 select grading_level into v_grade_level from find_donor_programs
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name;

 when others then
 handle_error;
 end ;
 
 begin
 don_core.find_donor(null,v_donor_last_name,to_date(:merged_donors.pr_dob,'mm-dd-yyyy'),

 v_total);

 end;

 copy_potential_duplicate;
 End if;

END IF;

END;
